capabilities.label: Manifest Contract
capabilities.description: CLI manifest presence, readability, schema validity, and parseability.

levels.name: No CLI manifest contract
levels.description: The target scenario has no readable CLI manifest contract for cli-health to validate.
levels.capability_summary: CLI contract validation cannot run against a readable manifest.

levels.name: Manifest parseable
levels.description: The CLI manifest can be parsed and schema validation can run.

levels.name: Manifest schema valid
levels.description: The CLI manifest conforms to the canonical schema and can be parsed by cli-core.

levels.name: Manifest clean
levels.description: The manifest contract has no provider-owned blocking findings.
levels.capability_summary: CLI manifest contract is clean enough for downstream checks.

capabilities.label: Proto Bindings
capabilities.description: Declared CLI commands bind to generated proto services and methods, with intentional omissions documented.

levels.name: Proto surface unavailable
levels.description: The scenario proto surface cannot be loaded for CLI binding checks.
levels.capability_summary: CLI/proto binding coverage cannot be evaluated.

levels.name: Proto surface readable
levels.description: The scenario proto surface can be loaded and compared with manifest bindings.
levels.capability_summary: CLI bindings can be compared with proto services.

levels.name: Command bindings valid
levels.description: Every declared command binding resolves to a known generated proto service and method.
levels.capability_summary: Manifest command bindings resolve to proto methods.
levels.next_unlock: Every proto method is bound or intentionally omitted.

levels.name: Proto/API coverage complete
levels.description: The scenario's proto methods are either exposed through CLI commands or deliberately omitted with a reason.
levels.capability_summary: CLI/proto coverage is complete and intentional.

capabilities.label: Runtime CLI Surface
capabilities.description: Optional runtime probing of the installed CLI binary and help-derived command surface.

levels.name: Runtime CLI unavailable
levels.description: The declared CLI binary cannot be resolved or executed in this run context.
levels.capability_summary: Runtime CLI behavior cannot be checked here.
levels.next_unlock: A resolvable CLI binary for runtime probing.

levels.name: CLI binary runnable
levels.description: The declared CLI binary can be executed for runtime surface checks.
levels.capability_summary: Runtime CLI probing can execute the binary.

levels.name: Help surface readable
levels.description: The runtime help surface can be parsed and compared with the manifest.
levels.next_unlock: Runtime commands agree with the manifest.

levels.name: Runtime surface aligned
levels.description: The runtime CLI command surface matches the manifest when execution checks are requested.
levels.capability_summary: Runtime CLI behavior is aligned with the manifest.

capabilities.label: Measures Metadata
capabilities.description: CLI command measure blocks are well-formed against proto-derived parameter schemas.

levels.name: Measure metadata invalid
levels.description: CLI measure blocks cannot be assembled or validated.
levels.capability_summary: CLI measure metadata cannot be trusted.
levels.next_unlock: Valid measure blocks and known parameter type annotations.

levels.name: Measure metadata readable
levels.description: Measure metadata is present enough for schema comparison, though degraded schema reads may remain.
levels.capability_summary: CLI measure metadata can be inspected.
levels.next_unlock: Measure blocks align with proto-derived schemas.

levels.name: Measures metadata valid
levels.description: CLI command measure blocks are well-formed against proto-derived parameter schemas.
levels.next_unlock: Full adoption-tier reporting without advisory gaps.

levels.name: Measures adoption clean
levels.description: Measure metadata is valid and adoption-tier findings are only informational or clean.
levels.capability_summary: CLI measure metadata is clean enough for discovery and governance reuse.

capabilities.label: Discovery Readiness
capabilities.description: The overall CLI contract is clean enough for command indexing, discovery, and governance reuse.

levels.name: Discovery blocked
levels.description: CLI discovery cannot rely on the current manifest, binding, runtime, or measures posture.
levels.capability_summary: Command discovery cannot safely reuse this CLI surface.
levels.next_unlock: Manifest, binding, runtime, and measure checks free of blocking findings.

levels.name: Discovery usable
levels.description: The CLI surface is usable for command discovery with only advisory debt remaining.
levels.capability_summary: Command discovery can index the CLI surface.
levels.next_unlock: No cli-health findings block or degrade command discovery.

levels.name: Discoverable CLI surface
levels.description: The CLI manifest is clean enough for command indexing, discovery, and governance reuse.
